# The Blue Logbook

*Ossie has something in his blue logbook he has told no one about. He wants you to check his dates against his gran's log.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Bain Harbour](../towns/bain_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Ossie](../npcs/ossie.md) |
| Level | 56 |
| After | [Keeping the Light](../quests/ysolde_keeping_the_light.md) |
| Leads to | [The Locked Chart](../quests/ambrose_the_locked_chart.md), [Birds for Miss Maren](../quests/ossie_birds_for_the_logbook.md) |

## Objectives

1. Bring 20 [Shade Lash](../items/shade_lash.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Ysolde](../npcs/ysolde.md)
3. Defeat 40 [Whipshade](../monsters/whipshade.md) in [The Crossways](../maps/crossways.md)

## Rewards

- 58,082 EXP
- 1,680 mesos
- +60 standing with [Ossie](../npcs/ossie.md)
- +25 standing with Bain Harbour
